consensus_findings.description: Nit: `--validation-report` pointing at a non-existent file is treated as a present report, so `--accept-missing-validation` is ignored and the check fails with a misleading pre_merge_gate "phases missing" detail instead of the OVERRIDE path. Spec requires the override when no validation report exists; probing uses `is_file()` (None when absent), but an explicit Path bypasses that. Reproduced: `expedite.py abc --validation-report /tmp/does-not-exist-xyz.md --accept-missing-validation docs --json` → ready false, overrides [], validation_report fail.

check_validation_report catches bare Exception around gate_logic.pre_merge_gate, so a programming error inside gate_logic would also be reported as 'failed to read validation-report.md'. It still fails closed (status=fail) and names the exception class, so the verdict is safe; narrowing to OSError/UnicodeDecodeError/ValueError would only sharpen the message.

Nit: `_override_reason` rejects blank reasons via `strip()` but returns the original unstripped string, so a reason like `"  docs-only  "` is accepted by the CLI and recorded with padding in both the OVERRIDE detail and `overrides[].reason`.

Nit: SKILL.md status table row `validation_report` (hard gate fail) says "pass `--force`" without naming the consumer. `expedite.py` has no `--force` flag; the check action correctly says "pass --force at merge time". Agents following the table alone may look for a non-existent expedite flag.

Optional: Spec cites permission denied as an unreadable-report failure mode, and SKILL.md documents it, but the suite only covers non-UTF-8 bytes and a directory path. The bare `except Exception` path would handle PermissionError, yet nothing pins that branch or its detail shape.

none: Core fail-closed path, recorded override, change_dir-from-id, worktree probe path, and SKILL↔code drift guard match the delta specs. 54 tests pass (`test_expedite.py` 48 + `test_skill_md_drift.py` 6); `test_table_rows_equal_failing_conditions` reconciles table (check, condition) rows with observed failing statuses, including override-as-pass and unreadable/hard-gate/rework branches.
